_comment: AY SFX library — source of truth. Edited by tools/sfx_editor.html (Bfxr-style UI) OR by hand. Compiled to code/sfx_data.asm by tools/build_sfx.py.

_schema.id: AYSFX_<UPPER_SNAKE>  — exported as EQU, indexes AySfxTable. Prefix evita colision con beeper SFX_* (sound.asm).
_schema.name: human-readable label (editor UI only)
_schema.channels: array of channels reserved while playing: A/B/C/N (noise). Music driver suppresses its own writes on these channels.
_schema.preset: editor metadata: which preset button generated this SFX (hit/blip/pickup/laser/explosion/jump/powerup/knock). Optional — only used by the editor to round-trip slider state.
_schema.params: editor metadata: slider values used by the preset to generate 'commands'. Optional. The COMPILED form is 'commands', not 'params'.
_schema.commands: the actual SFX program. Array of {op, ...args}. Ops: END, WAIT, TONE, VOL, MIXER, NOISE, ENV_SHAPE, ENV_PERIOD, SWEEP_TONE, SWEEP_VOL.
